question: 2025年各收货地区的非取消订单销售额中，高于各地区平均销售额的地区有哪些？（请给出地区名称与销售额）
gold_sql: WITH region_sales AS (SELECT o.region, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.region) SELECT region, ROUND(sales, 2) AS revenue FROM region_sales WHERE sales > (SELECT AVG(sales) FROM region_sales) ORDER BY revenue DESC, region
pred_sql: WITH region_sales AS (SELECT region, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total_sales FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' AND strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2025' GROUP BY region), avg_sales AS (SELECT AVG(total_sales) AS avg_total_sales FROM region_sales) SELECT rs.region, rs.total_sales FROM region_sales rs, avg_sales a WHERE rs.total_sales > a.avg_total_sales ORDER BY rs.total_sales DESC
